entry.title: dotMage 2.0.1 — team onboarding polish
entry.summary: Servers can advertise their own name so members skip the manual rename, single-server cleanup no longer wipes everything, and the web admin shows who you actually are.

entry.title: dotMage 2.0 — teams, same product, same license
entry.summary: Invite teammates with their own passwords, enforce roles, offboard people properly — and if you never invite anyone, nothing changes at all. AGPL everywhere, no paid tiers.

entry.title: dotMage 1.4.0 — key rotation, for everyone
entry.summary: One command re-encrypts your entire history with a fresh Account Key — resumable, verified with kill -9 mid-run, and it closes the oldest gap in the v1 threat model.

entry.title: dotMage 1.3.0 — any file, any server
entry.summary: Store XML/JSON/any config with encrypted metadata, map project directories to work/personal servers, self-update with dmage upgrade, and never push an empty .env again.

entry.title: dotMage 1.2 — and a blog to announce it on
entry.summary: App deletion, folders, smarter update checks — and this blog, where every release gets proper notes from now on.
